_readme: Repo allowlist for code agents — the trust boundary (docs/code-agents.md).
Copy to /data/code-agents/repos.json on the brain and edit; the file is
per-user state and never committed (this repo is public).
Only list repos you own or trust: the agent ingests AGENTS.md/.claude/
from whatever it clones, and the container is the blast-radius bound.
Only Tier 1/2 repos belong here (docs/privacy.md) — never the life vault.
name              short id used in chat names and the app's repo picker
url               HTTPS clone URL (private repos work via the PAT)
tier              1 or 2 — your own data classification, for the record
setup             command run in-container in the fresh workspace at
create time ('' = none). Keep it light: cpx21.
edit_only         true = no toolchain expectations; agent edits and
commits, checks run in CI or locally
allow_push        true = git push runs WITHOUT a permission ask for
chats on this repo (default false = every push asks)
public_throwaway  true = zen-free models are permitted for this repo
(hard rule 1: free models train on your data — only
